Carbon emits no font-family custom property for body styles (they inherit); codeSyntax left empty.

Type variables bind onto Text Styles through use_figma (verified in #27): weight 400 selects IBM Plex Sans Regular and px lineHeight and letterSpacing hold, so the text-node fallback is not used. letterSpacing reads back as float32 (0.16 -> 0.1599999964), so compare it with a tolerance.
Carbon line heights are unitless (1.28572); Figma binds lineHeight in px, so the variable holds size x ratio rounded (18, 22). codeSyntax still names the unitless CSS property.
